name: GatherParty
description: Call the whole party to the player.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for followers. Acts on the whole party. Followers are only teleported to you if all are over 2000 units away and out of sight.
prompt: If the player calls the whole party or everyone to gather or come to them, begin your response with '{key}:'
